mascot: Sunny and Shady — twin parrots, one bright yellow and one deep grey: Sunny collects words that mean the same, Shady collects opposites.

slides.title: Word Cousins: Synonyms 👯
slides.text: Synonyms are different words that mean almost the same thing! Big and large. Happy and glad. They are word cousins!
slides.spoken: Synonyms mean almost the same: big and large, happy and glad!

slides.title: Word Opposites: Antonyms 🔄
slides.text: Antonyms are words with opposite meanings! Big and small. Hot and cold. Day and night. They are word opposites!
slides.spoken: Antonyms are opposites: big and small, hot and cold!

slides.title: Sunny's Synonym Nest 🌞
slides.text: In Sunny's nest: begin and start, smart and clever, happy and cheerful. Same meaning, different word!
slides.spoken: Begin and start, smart and clever — synonyms in the nest!

slides.title: Shady's Antonym Cave 🌚
slides.text: In Shady's cave: open and shut, fast and slow, up and down. Opposite meanings, perfect pairs!
slides.spoken: Open and shut, fast and slow — antonyms in the cave!

slides.title: Word Power! 💪
slides.text: Knowing synonyms and antonyms makes your writing strong! Instead of 'big', try 'huge'! Instead of 'sad', try 'unhappy'!
slides.spoken: Synonyms and antonyms make your writing strong!

challenges.question: A synonym means almost the same as another word. Which is a synonym of 'big'?
challenges.hint: Which word could replace big and keep the same meaning?
challenges.misconception: Large means almost the same as big — they are synonyms! Small and tiny are opposites.

challenges.question: Which is a synonym of 'happy'?
challenges.hint: Which word also means feeling joyful?
challenges.misconception: Glad means almost the same as happy — synonyms! Sad and angry are opposites.

challenges.question: Which is an antonym of 'hot'?
challenges.hint: Antonyms are opposites. What do you feel on ice?
challenges.misconception: Cold is the opposite (antonym) of hot! Warm and boiling are close to hot.

challenges.question: Which is an antonym of 'fast'?
challenges.hint: A tortoise is one, a cheetah is the other!
challenges.misconception: Slow is the opposite (antonym) of fast! Quick and speedy mean fast.

challenges.question: Which two words mean almost the same?
challenges.hint: Which pair could swap places in a sentence?
challenges.misconception: Begin and start mean almost the same — synonyms! Big and small are opposites.

challenges.question: Which two words are opposites?
challenges.hint: Which pair cannot be true at the same time?
challenges.misconception: Open and shut are opposites — antonyms! Cup and mug, and soft and gentle, mean almost the same.

challenges.question: Drag each word! Does it mean the same as 'happy' or the opposite?
challenges.hint: Glad and cheerful mean happy. Sad and angry mean the opposite!
challenges.misconception: Glad and Cheerful are synonyms of happy. Sad and Angry are antonyms!

challenges.question: Which is a synonym of 'smart'?
challenges.hint: Someone smart makes good choices. Which word means the same?
challenges.misconception: Clever means almost the same as smart — synonyms! Silly and sleepy are different.
